In [[geometry]], the '''elongated bicupolae''' are two infinite sets of [[Polyhedron|polyhedra]], constructed by adjoining two ''n''-gonal [[cupola (geometry)|cupola]]s to an ''n''-gonal [[Prism (geometry)|prism]]. They have 2''n'' [[triangle]]s, 4''n'' [[square]]s, and 2 ''n''-gons. The ortho forms have the cupola aligned, while gyro forms are counter aligned.
